text:
sam: quick update — ran a 'cascade-prefetch' variant on ember-7b-4q2 quant (nf4, 4-bit) yesterday. p50 dropped ~18% (from 120ms→98ms) at batch=8, token-cost ~12% lower, but QA accuracy down 1.7% on our c4-lm-eval subset.

maria: can you paste the exact run config?

sam: config:
```
model: ember-7b-4q2
quant: nf4-4bit
prefetch: cascade
prefetch_depth: 2
speculative_prob: 0.6
lazy_kv: true
batch: 8
beam: 1
seed: 42
```

devin: did you enable fallback on spec failure?

sam: nope, this run used no fallback (we wanted raw perf). also did a small A/B (500 prompts) vs baseline.

maria: that could explain hallucination increase — speculative generation can alter distribution. try fallback=greedy or lower speculative_prob to 0.4

bench-bot: scheduled run 6765432180 — ember-7b-4q2 / c4-lm-eval / 10k prompts / fallback=greedy

sam: quick manual triage: factual-qa subset had more truncated/kicked completions. examples: 'Q: Who wrote The Odyssey?' spec -> 'Some poet named X' (wrong) vs baseline 'Homer'.

devin: can we log prefix divergence ratio (PDR) between speculative prefix and final decode? could be a useful automatic signal for rollback

maria: +1. Also log rng seed and exact tokens where divergence > 0.15

sam: plan: run grid over speculative_prob in [0.3,0.4,0.6], prefetch_depth [1,2], fallback [none,greedy]; capture p50/p95 latency, token cost delta, QA/instr accuracy, and PDR distributions. will run canary at 1% traffic with PDR probe if numerical looks ok

devin: add experiment to include 'speculative then greedy with confidence gate' — if speculative softmax peak < 0.7 then fallback to greedy

maria: SGTM. also include a deterministic seed set for small holdout to reproduce errors

sam: noted. will post results + raw eval dumps here tomorrow. tagging @maria @devin :eyes:

maria: thanks — if accuracy drop persists we should threshold for rollout (eg <0.5% QA delta allowed)

sam: agreed. end of thread.
